17.1.name: JAM.Auditing.auditReports
17.1.note: the first argument `V` is |κ|; ρ is read at the indices below |κ|/3 (note v0.8.1-A12)

17.2.name: JAM.Auditing.auditReports
17.2.note: the first argument `V` is |κ|; reports are compared by their encoding

17.5.name: JAM.Auditing.tranche0
17.5.note: a sequence in shuffle order rather than a set; `y` is 𝒴(s₀)

17.6.name: JAM.Auditing.currentTranche
17.6.note: natural subtraction: a wall clock before the slot reads as tranche 0 (note v0.8.1-A12)

17.7.name: JAM.Auditing.announcementValid
17.7.note: the message is `JAM.Auditing.announcementMessage`, n encoded as ℰ(n) (note v0.8.1-A9)

17.8.name: JAM.Auditing.announcementItems
17.8.note: the set's elements in lexicographic order (note v0.8.1-A9)

17.10.name: JAM.Auditing.View
17.10.note: A_n is the input `announced`, keyed by ℋ(𝐫); a set of validators is a `JAM.Auditing.VSet`

17.12.name: JAM.Auditing.View
17.12.note: J_⊤ and J_⊥ are the inputs `positive` and `negative`, keyed by ℋ(𝐫)

17.13.name: JAM.Auditing.laterSeedValid
17.13.note: the context is `JAM.Auditing.laterContext`, n encoded as ℰ(n) (note v0.8.1-A9)

17.14.name: JAM.Auditing.laterSelected
17.14.note: decided multiplied out, |κ|·ℰ₂⁻¹(…) < 65536·F·m; the no-show count m is `JAM.Auditing.noShows`

17.15.name: JAM.Auditing.laterTranche
17.15.note: a sequence rather than a set; `JAM.Auditing.laterTrancheWithNegatives` adds the prose's negative-judgment rule (note v0.8.1-A10)

17.16.reason: eₙ is not defined as one function: the evaluation is an input to `JAM.Auditing.judgmentValid`; its parts are `JAM.Guarantee.verifyBundle` and Ξ, `JAM.Guarantee.computeReport`

17.17.name: JAM.Auditing.judgmentValid
17.17.note: the message is `JAM.Auditing.judgmentMessage`; eₙ(𝐫) is the input `valid`

17.18.name: JAM.Auditing.Audited
17.18.note: ∃n is bounded by the current tranche (note v0.8.1-A8); `JAM.Auditing.AuditedLiteral` is the literal reading, and `JAM.Auditing.audited` decides `Audited`
